items.name: Potion of Cohesion Healing
items.effect: Restores 1d4 hit points for each creature in your cohesion (minimum of 1d4.
items.description: A bubbling crimson liquid in a stoppered glass vial.

items.name: Cloak of Sealing Wind
items.effect: You ignore winds and windy forces.

items.name: Bottle Bomb
items.effect: When this bottle breaks, each creature within 15ft of it must succeed in a DC 13 dexterity saving throw, receiving 2d6 bludgeoning damage on a failure, or half as much on a successful save.

items.name: Potion of First Responders
items.effect: Action to drink: For the next 1 hour, you make your initiative rolls with advantage. If you are in initiative order right now, reroll your initiative order.
items.description: Blue and grimey liquid that seems hard to swallow.

items.name: Spear of Gravity
items.effect:
+1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon.
Dawnbound: You may expend your action to force each other creature within 15ft of you to make a DC 17 strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature receives 2d6 force damage and is pulled towards you until it cannot be pulled further due to something blocking it, or until it is within 5ft of you. The spear can be used like this once, and it regains the use next dawn.
items.description: It feels almost weightless when actually being wielded, as if it had its own anchor-point in spacetime.

items.name: Tactical Goo
items.effect: As an action you hurl this vial of goo at a position within 30ft of yourself. The vial cracks on impact, and turns that position into difficult terrain.
items.description: It's green and smells bad. It's also extremely viscous.
